load.scenario: Each user creates a private session/thread and sends 12 sequential annual-leave questions, exercising history up to 20 messages. Each response must be HTTP 201, include the correct 20-day answer and at least one source. Browser tests additionally cover document CRUD and memory save/delete across threads.
